name: Receipts
technicalDescription: One receipt per bank transfer. Receipt first (plan r3 stage 1, 03.11): created as a draft as soon as the customer is identified (IdentifyCustomers), before any invoice match. amount is always the transfer amount. receiptStatus is the single status: טיוטה – ממתינה לאישור → אושרה – לא נשלחה (approved in the task, together with its match proposal, or by itself when autoCloseReceipts is on) → הונפקה ב-Priority (a person marked it issued, with Priority's receipt number). matchStatus: התאמה מוצעת – לאישור / מותאמת / על חשבון – צריך התאמה. The old status column was removed in step 3. The app never writes to Priority. Its allocations are ReceiptAllocations.

columns.name: receiptKey
columns.description: Key: RCPT-<bankLineId> for a bank line; RCPT-AGT-<paymentRef> for a field agent's cheque (receiptSource צ׳ק סוכן)

columns.name: bankLineId
columns.description: The transfer (BankLines.bankLineId)

columns.name: importBatchId
columns.description: The bank file (ImportBatches.id)

columns.name: matchProposalId
columns.description: The approved MatchProposals row id

columns.name: customerCode
columns.description: Customer code

columns.name: customerName
columns.description: Customer name (denormalised)

columns.name: payerName
columns.description: Payer name as on the bank line

columns.name: reference
columns.description: Bank reference

columns.name: valueDate
columns.description: Value date of the transfer

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Receipt amount = the transfer amount, ILS

columns.name: allocatedAmount
columns.description: Sum of the allocations

columns.name: unallocatedAmount
columns.description: amount − allocatedAmount: left on account (על חשבון)

columns.name: matchStatus
columns.description: Allocation state of the receipt (plan 04.11 part B): empty until the debt check; פיזור מוצע – לאישור (CheckDebt closed a month to 0 and proposed the invoices) / על חשבון – צריך פיזור / מפוזרת / מפוזרת – עודף על חשבון (ApplyAllocation)

columns.name: receiptStatus
columns.description: The receipt's single status (plan r3 stage 1): created as a draft when the customer is identified, approved in one task together with its match proposal (or by itself when autoCloseReceipts is on), marked issued when a person issues it in Priority. Priority is not connected, so approved = not sent

columns.name: priorityReceiptNumber
columns.description: Priority's receipt number, typed by the person who issued it

columns.name: preparedBy
columns.description: Who approved the split

columns.name: preparedAt
columns.description: When

columns.name: issuedBy
columns.description: Who marked it issued in Priority

columns.name: issuedAt
columns.description: When

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: identifyConfidence
columns.description: Plan 04.11 part B: customer identification confidence 0–100

columns.name: identifyStatus
columns.description: Customer identification state (certain = at or above identifyCertainAt)

columns.name: debtCheckResult
columns.description: Debt check against OpenMovements right after the receipt

columns.name: debtCheckMonths
columns.description: Due months the receipt closed, comma-separated YYYY-MM

columns.name: allocationConfidence
columns.description: Allocation proposal confidence 0–100

columns.name: sentToEmail
columns.description: The customer's accounts-payable contact the receipt was addressed to

columns.name: sentAt
columns.description: When it was sent (never in testing)

columns.name: sendStatus
columns.description: Receipt mail state

columns.name: receiptSource
columns.description: Where the money came from
